question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No. 1.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The context of the passage suggests that a specific number of years is needed to indicate how long Mr. Reed has been dead, and** "nine"** fits perfectly as it is a clear and specific duration.
 
• "**An**" and "**the**" are articles that do not indicate a specific duration of time.
 
• "**Complete**" is an adjective that does not provide a specific measure of time.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Mr. Reed had been dead for nine__ years: it was in this chamber he (2) _________ his last; here he (3) ________ in state; hence his coffin was (4) _________ by the undertaker's men; and, since that day, a (5) ___________ of dreary consecration had guarded it from frequent intrusion.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **An (एक)**: an indefinite article used before words starting with a vowel sound.
 
• **The (यह)**: a definite article used to specify a particular noun that is known to the reader.
 
• **Complete (पूर्ण)**: an adjective meaning whole or finished.
